messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT 1778754321 - HIGH 5xx rate and elevated latency from eu-central-1 observed across hosted API routes. Error rate ~14% (5xx), p95 latency up to 1.8s. Source: provider telemetry + runtime traces. Paging infra on-call @kevin. Severity P1. Dashboard: https://dash.internal.redwood/incident/1778754321

kevin: ack, I'm on it. pulling up the traces and checking provider health. starting a quick triage.

maya: saw the spike too — provider reports increased network errors and some OOMs on a subset of instances in eu-central. If we can't get a quick fix, propose partial brownout for non-critical features and a controlled reroute to another EU region (gcp-europe-west1) to reduce pressure.

kevin: plan (proposed):
1) apply targeted rate limit for long-running streaming / large-token requests (>=2048 tokens).
2) reroute ~30% of traffic from eu-central-1 -> gcp-eu-west1 as fallback.
3) disable vector-store reranking for hosted tier (non-enterprise) for 15m.
4) start draining the affected provider pool in eu-central after reroute stabilizes.
I will apply (1) + (3) immediately, then kick off the reroute.

liz: quick Q — will any enterprise customers be impacted by the rerank brownout? need to flag support and CSMs.

kevin: short answer: no large committed enterprise tenants should see rerank disabled. Affected: some mid-market and trial accounts. Posting rough list: acme-io, pixl-app, dataforge-sandbox (non-prod).

ops-bot: Running command: `rdrctl config apply`
```
{
  "route": "api.text.generate",
  "condition": "input_tokens >= 2048 || streaming == true",
  "action": "rate_limit",
  "limit": "2r/s per customer",
  "duration": "15m",
  "operator": "oncall-kevin"
}
```

ops-bot: Feature flag updated: `feature.vector_rerank` set to `off` for plan:hosted, scope:non-enterprise, duration:15m.

kevin: applied the throttle and turned off rerank. watching metrics. starting reroute now (30%):
`rdrctl routing reroute --from=eu-central-1 --to=gcp-eu-west1 --pct=30 --reason="mitigation-1778754321"`

ops-bot: Command accepted. Job id: 8b3c2a. Progress: 0% -> 18% -> 45%...

kevin: reroute progressing. pulling up per-region error rates.

kevin: metrics snapshot (after initial reroute):
- eu-central error rate: 9% -> 4% (after 30% offload)
- gcp-eu-west1 error rate: 0.8%
- overall p95 latency: 1.8s -> 480ms

maya: good drop. suggest we also drain the specific provider pool showing OOMs to prevent reintroduction of bad nodes. I'll prepare infra command.

ops-bot: `rdrctl infra drain-pool --provider=aws-eu-central-1 --pool=prod-inference-3 --grace=60s`

ops-bot: Drain initiated. Instances cordoned: 12. Active flows migrated: 8. Status: draining.

liz: support — please update customer comms. Which tenants should we proactively message? I'll draft a note for mid-market customers.

support-bot: Status page updated: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1778754321 — severity: degraded. Post includes current mitigation steps and estimated time-to-reassess 20m.

kevin: monitoring metrics continuously. After drain started, eu-central error rate down to 3%. p95 ~320ms. Will keep throttles + reroute for now.

maya: recommend keeping vector-rerank off for 20 minutes total, then re-evaluate on a small canary group before full restore. Also recommend keeping the 30% reroute for at least 15 minutes to ensure stability.

kevin: agree. scheduling canary restore: restore rerank to 5% of traffic in gcp-eu-west1 then watch.

sara: I can take the watch from here for the next 45m. please leave a concise handoff with commands run and current state.

kevin: handing off to @sara. Handoff summary:
- Mitigations applied: rate limit for long streams (2r/s per cust, 15m), feature.vector_rerank = off for hosted (15m), 30% traffic reroute eu-central -> gcp-eu-west1, drained pool prod-inference-3 in aws-eu-central-1.
- Current metrics: overall 5xx ~3%, p95 latency ~320ms, reroute job 100% for targeted fraction, drain job active (12 cordoned, migrating flows).
- Commands run (audit):
  - `rdrctl config apply` (throttle JSON)
  - `rdrctl routing reroute --from=eu-central-1 --to=gcp-eu-west1 --pct=30 --reason=mitigation-1778754321`
  - `rdrctl infra drain-pool --provider=aws-eu-central-1 --pool=prod-inference-3 --grace=60s`
- Customer impact: mid-market/trial tenants (acme-io, pixl-app, dataforge-sandbox) may see degraded rerank/long-request throttles. No enterprise SLA violations expected.

sara: ack, taking handoff. I'll monitor dashboards and logs. If error rate stays <=1% and p95 <=200ms for 30m, plan to restore vector-rerank for hosted and reduce reroute to 10% then full removal. If anything regresses I'll escalate back into this thread and page @kevin.

kevin: thanks. leaving one final note — watch for surge in retry traffic from SDK clients; we might need to bump burst allowances to avoid client-side cascading failures.

support-bot: Noted. Support teams alerted and templated customer message queued for mid-market tenants.

incidents-bot: :white_check_mark: Mitigation applied and under watch. Incident remains open for monitoring. Next automated reassess at +20m.
